FAQ

Common questions

Can ABiT provide remote developers for an existing team?

Yes. ABiT can provide developers, ERP specialists, QA and support resources who align with an existing backlog and delivery process.

Do outsourced teams handle ERP projects?

Yes. ABiT outsourced teams can support SAP Business One, Odoo, ERPNext, custom ERP, portals, integrations and reporting work.

Can the engagement include support after delivery?

Yes. ABiT can provide ongoing support, enhancements and monitoring after a project or implementation goes live.
